videoDetails.title: Don't underestimate the communication barrier
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Closing the Communication Gap With AI Agents

Learn why the biggest obstacle to getting better outputs from AI agents isn't the model itself—it's the communication barrier between you and the agent. Discover how to think about what your agent doesn't know about you and what you actually want.
